Name: Moon Berries
Author: XxHarvzBackxX
Description:
Moon Berries are "shimmering purple berries, said to have magical properties".
This mod was made by AI in a fun project I did to test the limits of Artifical Intelligence Tools, such as Chat-GPT, DALL-E 2, and CrAIyon.

Moon Berry seeds are bought at Pierre's for 30 gold each. Moon Berries can be grown only in Fall and Winter, and can be sold for 50 gold each.
Find out more information about the mod and the process of it's creation [url=https://youtu.be/j2fcG1pTzYM]here.[/url]
